tests: [connect.test] Puppeteer.connect should be able to connect using browserUrl, with and without trailing slash
reason: Connects with Puppeteer's `browserURL`, Chromium's HTTP DevTools endpoint, from which Puppeteer reads the WebSocket URL. Firefox's connect takes its WebSocket endpoint directly, so there's no `browserURL` to test on Firefox

tests: [connect.test] Puppeteer.connect should be able to connect using browserUrl, with and without trailing slash
[connect.test] Puppeteer.connect should throw when trying to connect to non-existing browser
reason: Connects a client to the running browser. Stock WebKit's layer has no connect; Chromium and Firefox connect with their own layers, so the port runs them there

tests: [connect.test] Puppeteer.connect should throw when using both browserWSEndpoint and browserURL
reason: Passes both `browserWSEndpoint` and `browserURL` and checks Puppeteer's refusal to choose between them. Strider's connect takes one endpoint, so the combination can't be written
